description: Small, versioned retrieval set covering exact terms, synonyms, concepts, hard negatives, and no-result queries.

learnings.title: Retry transient HTTP failures
learnings.body: Retry HTTP 429 and 503 responses with exponential backoff and jitter. Do not retry permanent 4xx errors.

learnings.title: Validate before database writes
learnings.body: Use the shared validation helper before inserting user input. Direct writes bypass schema checks.

learnings.title: Bound agent context
learnings.body: Retrieve a ranked shortlist and expand only selected records instead of placing the complete knowledge base in the model context.

learnings.title: Pin the iroh test port
learnings.body: Use a stable UDP port when simulating two peers on one machine so ticket addresses remain reachable across processes.

learnings.title: Keep embeddings local
learnings.body: Synchronize canonical text through iroh and rebuild model-specific vector indexes independently on every peer.

learnings.title: Use idempotency keys for payments
learnings.body: Attach a stable idempotency key to payment creation requests so safe retries cannot charge a customer twice.

learnings.title: Redact secrets from logs
learnings.body: Structured logs must exclude access tokens, passwords, private keys, and full sensitive document bodies.

learnings.title: Handle graceful shutdown
learnings.body: Stop accepting work, drain in-flight tasks, flush persistent state, and then close network transports.

learnings.title: Measure retrieval quality
learnings.body: Track Recall at K, mean reciprocal rank, no-result accuracy, and latency on a versioned query set.

learnings.title: Avoid blocking the async runtime
learnings.body: Run CPU-heavy inference and synchronous model loading on a blocking worker rather than a Tokio executor thread.
